label: GO step after an unrewarded trial (recent-non-reward signal)
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.7% of mass; never at D1, ~0 at D2). Strongest when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 81% of mass, precision 0.81 on dev, top-quartile coverage 99.6%). Magnitude grows over a run of consecutive unrewarded trials (examples climb 0.4->0.8->1.0) and decays slowly after rewards, so many weak firings at GO after a reward that followed recent non-reward make up the missed recall (low quartiles). Does not fire at D1 (where the reward is shown) or on rewarded-streak GOs. Also fades late in episodes (almost silent after trial 80); adding ep_trial<80 raises dev F1 0.71->0.75 and precision to 0.98, but the simpler predicate was recorded. Uses only observed variables.
